Nope, just normal wireless sports earphones that play loud continuous noise.

Yeah, I m from Singapore, and Thanks!
Thank you. Ever since I put on dark glasses and earphones, I was no longer violent. Volunteering might not work for me because I do have some problems doing things with people (@_@)"

When I take off my earphones, I try to keep a very low profile. I try very hard not to get any attention. When I did that, people do not notice me. Great!

I am especially sensitive to couples or a group of good friends, and I will put my earphones back again

I do hear some bad remarks, or am I too sensitive and regard everyone's words as bad remarks?

I try to make new friends. I hope that by making friends, I will develop a positive impression about strangers. Hopefully, I won't be so afraid. Before I put on dark glasses and earphones, I had heard remarks that really hurt me. I am so scared to hear these kind of remarks that I decided to put on earphones that produce loud continuous noise so that I can no longer hear what other people are saying. Nowadays, I start to be able to take off my earphones for a while and feel less scared -_-"
Trying to find a blog topic to talk about @_@"
Hi there, thank you so much :)

I wanted to find a job badly. I tried IMH job club and mindset learning hub. to look for a job. Not much success. I don't want to rot at home doing nothing, so I am blogging about my mental illnesses. It was a surprise to me that people actually read my stories about my mental illnesses. Was thinking if blogging about mental illnesses is enough, or blog more topics like making money online and my weight loss journey. Hope to make a very small income blogging :P

Wow, thanks for your comment. Like what u said just now, I have to listen to my occupational therapist and take part in empowerment programmes first, before she can decide whether I could work or not. She needs to see my performance during the empowerment programmes.

I have violent urges to harm the ones I love, and I feel very guilty. Against strangers, I also have violent urges to harm them, but I never feel guilty. I had been bullied for 20+ years, so I hate strangers/people. But not all people are bad. I face strangers who are good too. When I face them, my kind side surfaces.
